description: Financial boundary policy: company finance is separate from external royalties and from society, association and distributor transfers. Consumers: finance-operations-agent, payment-operations-agent, financial-reconciliation-agent, payments-reviewer and report-automation-agent.
rules: external amounts are information and are never booked automatically as company income or expense
totals never combine the two domains
amounts use exact decimal arithmetic and explicit currency
payments are prepared with a verified basis and executed only after a recorded payment approval
corrections of financial data are proposals until a human approves them
reconciliations of the two domains are separate
